items.q: How many days of annual leave do I get?
items.a:
Full-time employees get 24 days of annual leave per year, plus public holidays. Unused leave
up to 5 days carries over to the next year.

items.q: How do I apply for leave?
items.a:
Submit the request in the HR portal at least two weeks ahead for leave longer than three days.
Your manager approves it in the portal.

items.q: What is the sick leave policy?
items.a: Up to 10 paid sick days per year. For more than 3 days in a row, upload a doctor's note.
Salary is paid on the last working day of every month. Payslips appear in the HR portal two days before.

items.q: What is the parental leave policy?
items.a:
Primary caregivers get 26 weeks of paid leave and secondary caregivers get 6 weeks, available to
all employees after 6 months of service.

items.q: How do I claim travel expenses?
items.a:
Submit the claim in the expense tool within 30 days with a photo of each receipt. Claims over 500
need a pre-approved travel request.

items.q: What is the daily meal allowance when travelling?
items.a: Up to 40 per day for domestic travel and up to 60 per day abroad. Alcohol is not reimbursed.

items.q: How do I claim my home internet costs?
items.a: Employees who work from home at least 2 days a week can claim up to 30 per month through the expense tool.

items.q: Where do I find the learning budget?
items.a:
Every employee has a learning budget of 1,000 per year for courses, books and conferences.
Request it in the HR portal with a short note on how it helps your role.
